// CASE top_level_generic expect=pass
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

class Pool {
  // CASE static_method expect=pass
  static Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<T, R>(
    List<T> items,
    int width,
    Future<R> Function(T) operation,
  ) async {
    final results = <R>[];
    for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
      final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
      results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map((item) => operation(item))));
    }
    return results;
  }

  // CASE instance_method_typed_list expect=pass
  Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency2<T, R>(
    List<T> items,
    int width,
    Future<R> Function(T) operation,
  ) async {
    final List<R> results = [];
    for (int offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
      final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
      results.addAll(
        await Future.wait<R>(group.map((item) async => await operation(item))),
      );
    }
    return results;
  }
}

extension ConcurrentMap<T> on List<T> {
  // CASE extension_method expect=pass
  Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency<R>(
    int width,
    Future<R> Function(T) operation,
  ) async {
    final results = <R>[];
    for (var offset = 0; offset < length; offset += width) {
      final group = skip(offset).take(width);
      results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
    }
    return results;
  }
}

// CASE non_generic_dynamic expect=pass
Future<List<dynamic>> mapWithConcurrency3(
  List<dynamic> items,
  int width,
  Future<dynamic> Function(dynamic) operation,
) async {
  final results = <dynamic>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE doc_comment_and_assert expect=pass
/// Runs [operation] over [items], [width] at a time.
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency4<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  assert(width > 0, 'width must be positive');
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map(operation)));
  }
  return results;
}

// CASE block_body_return_await expect=pass
Future<List<R>> mapWithConcurrency5<T, R>(
  List<T> items,
  int width,
  Future<R> Function(T) operation,
) async {
  final results = <R>[];
  for (var offset = 0; offset < items.length; offset += width) {
    final group = items.skip(offset).take(width);
    results.addAll(
      await Future.wait(
        group.map((item) async {
          return await operation(item);
        }),
      ),
    );
  }
  return results;
}
